enabled.name: Conditions engine
enabled.hint: Master switch. Off: the module changes nothing and posts nothing.

chat.name: Chat lines
chat.hint: Post a line when a condition starts or ends.

npcGmOnly.name: NPC lines to the GM only
npcGmOnly.hint: Whisper chat lines about actors no player owns to the GM.

stances.name: Stances
stances.hint: Full: using a stance's action switches the stance on (its effects apply) and shows it on the token. Remind: a chat line only.

mode.remind: Remind only: a chat reminder, no changes

durations.name: Durations
durations.hint: Full: effects end by themselves when their duration runs out (turns follow Foundry's turn order, as Advanced Encounters sets it). Remind: a chat line says it would end now.

askDuration.name: Ask for a duration
askDuration.hint: When a condition is turned on from the token or sheet, ask how long it lasts.

combatEndsScene.name: Ending combat ends the scene
combatEndsScene.hint: When an encounter is ended, also do the end of the scene for its combatants (effects that last until the end of the scene, stances, per-scene uses).

sceneRecharge.name: Recharge per-scene uses at the end of a scene
sceneRecharge.hint: Items whose uses recharge per scene (such as Recover) get them back.

rolls.name: Advantage and disadvantage on tests
rolls.hint: Full: conditions, situational effects, stances and effects with rules of their own (yours and your target's) set the test's advantage or disadvantage; the roll dialog starts with it selected, so the player can change it. Remind: the chat card lists them, the roll is unchanged. Each condition's own setting, and "Rules on other effects" for other effects, must also be full.

actionEffects.name: Effects from Dodge, Brace and Gain Advantage
actionEffects.hint: Full: using these actions puts their effect on the token (Gain Advantage after the player confirms success), and the roll layer reads it. Remind: a chat line only.

otherEffects.name: Rules on other effects
otherEffects.hint: Rules carried by effects that are not one of the module's conditions or situational effects (a talent's, a stance's, an item's or a homebrew effect's). Full: their movement and skill changes and their advantages and disadvantages apply. Remind: they change nothing (the chat card of a test still lists their advantages and disadvantages). A condition's rules follow that condition's own setting.

chat.stanceEnded: {actor} is no longer in a stance.
chat.stanceRemindHint: Its effects are not switched on automatically (stances are in remind-only mode).
chat.wouldExpireHint: Remove it by hand (durations are in remind-only mode).
chat.grantAsk: {actor} tries to gain the advantage over {target}.
chat.afflictedRemind: {actor}'s {effect} deals its damage now (end of its turn).
chat.afflictedRemindHint: Apply {amount} {type} damage (Afflicted is in remind-only mode).
chat.surprisedSlow: {actor} is Surprised and cannot take a fast turn: moved to a slow turn.
chat.surprisedRemind: {actor} is Surprised and cannot take a fast turn.
chat.surprisedRemindHint: Move it to a slow turn (Surprised is in remind-only mode).
chat.surprisedBossHint: Skip its fast turn (a boss keeps its slow turn).

dialog.endSceneBody: End the scene for the tokens on this scene? Effects that last until the end of the scene end, stances end and per-scene uses recharge, as the module settings say.

notify.needsTarget: {action}: target one enemy to track the advantage.
notify.noGM: No GM is connected to remove {effect}; remove it by hand.
notify.linkLoop: {actor}: {parent} would bring {condition}, which is already being applied here. Not linked again; check the rules of these effects for a loop.
notify.linkDepth: {actor}: the links from {parent} to {condition} go too deep. Stopped; check the rules of these effects for a loop.

duration.phaseNextRound: Until the start of this phase next round
duration.startOfNextTurn: Until the start of its next turn
duration.endOfTurn: Until the end of its turn
duration.endOfNextTurn: Until the end of its next turn
duration.endOfScene: Until the end of the scene

rules.title: Rules: {effect}
rules.defaultsFrom: Defaults: the module's table entry for {kind} "{id}".
rules.noDefaults: This effect has no defaults from the module's tables.
rules.nothing: Nothing: this effect has no rules.
rules.ignored: The rules saved on this effect are ignored (the defaults apply) because:
rules.ownHint: A field set here replaces the default as a whole; a field left out keeps the default. Blank: no rules of its own.
